gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-radio-canada-big: Fuzzy Bubbles writes in rounded, friendly letters, with small letters nearly as tall as its capitals. Radio Canada Big follows in a sans with a monoline build and an x-height that fills the line, so bump its size up a notch.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-readex-pro: Relaxed and personal, Fuzzy Bubbles looks hand-drawn with a drafting pen. Readex Pro settles underneath in a plain sans, its terminals gapped wide and its weight unvarying, so the heading earns its keep when it is big and brief.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-roboto: Relaxed handwriting leads here: Fuzzy Bubbles has a y whose tail is as thick as its arm. Roboto carries the text in a sans with generous mouths on its round letters, so a long page keeps moving without friction.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-ruda: Fuzzy Bubbles brings rounded, open handwriting drawn with the steady line of a drafting pen, nothing fussy about it. Ruda's sans text is wire-thin and wide-mouthed, easy going on screens.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-saira: Fuzzy Bubbles draws a single-weight line like a plotter pen would, rounded and personal, with small letters nearly capital height. Saira's sans-serif sits beneath it, see-through in each s.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-sarpanch: Sarpanch reads approachable, with a clearly open e and ascenders held close to the x-height. And Fuzzy Bubbles overhead, its strokes free of contrast, can stay large while the sans text stays modest.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-savate: Strokes like a bent steel rod give Fuzzy Bubbles its handwritten, relaxed look. Savate answers in a plain sans whose gentle modulation never snags the eye, and its tall round o nearly matches the capital.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-schibsted-grotes: Fuzzy Bubbles is handwritten and relaxed, its bold-looking and light-looking strokes never mixing within a word. Schibsted Grotesk takes over with big open-looking e and a shapes, and its terminals never close in.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-scope-one: Fuzzy Bubbles draws every line without any thick-thin shift, like a steel cable outline, in friendly handwriting. Scope One brings traditional serif refinement, with stubby ascenders and counters that spill outward, which is the pair's real charm.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-sen: Hand-drawn warmth meets tall type. Fuzzy Bubbles is rounded and personal, while Sen's sans-serif lowercase, built tall in a constant weight, gives the pairing its clearest contrast.
